title: Page Orientation
description: Natural reading orientation of a raster page image, with the clockwise rotation required to make it upright.

angle.description: Clockwise rotation, in degrees, required to make the page upright.

stage.description: Detection stage or terminal reason that produced the angle.

auto_rotated.description: True when a non-zero rotation makes the page upright.

original_width.description: Width of the source image in pixels, when known.

original_height.description: Height of the source image in pixels, when known.

oriented_width.description: Width after applying the detected rotation, in pixels.

oriented_height.description: Height after applying the detected rotation, in pixels.

image_base64.description: Oriented image payload, base64-encoded, when requested.

media_type.description: Media type of the returned image payload, when requested.
